name: Log Press
instructions: Lift the log to your chest using a clean, with your elbows under it.
Set your feet shoulder-width apart and brace your core.
Dip slightly and drive the log upward, pressing it overhead.
Lock out your arms with the log over your mid-foot.
Lower the log back to your chest under control.
longevityNotes: Pressing strength keeps daily pushing — doors, shelves, getting up from the floor — easy and safe. Controlled pressing builds the shoulders, chest, and arms that protect you in a fall.
overview: A strongman-style overhead press with a log that trains the shoulders, triceps and whole-body stability.
